# Ting 0.7.1
## Changes
- Selecta supports arrow-key selection and Return to open an action or group. The selected row is highlighted; the existing binding keys still work.
- The amber top rule follows the rounded outline of the launcha, leader and micro-app panels instead of extending beyond their upper corners. - Up, Down, Page Up and Page Down navigate launcha results even when keyboard focus leaves the search field. Text composition and modified keys retain their editing behavior. - Refreshing or reordering launcha results keeps the selected result in view instead of scrolling back to the first row. - Command-arrow and Command-delete shortcuts reach the text editor in micro-app panels, including combinations with Shift and Option.
## Upgrade and install
Requires macOS 14 or later. The universal ZIP supports Apple Silicon and Intel. Choose **Check for Updates…** in Ting to upgrade. Settings, bindings, micro-apps and permissions are preserved.
For a manual installation, download `Ting-0.7.1-universal.zip` from [Releases](https://github.com/bobuk-io/ting/releases/tag/v0.7.1), quit Ting, replace `/Applications/Ting.app` with the extracted app, and open it. The release is signed with Developer ID, notarized by Apple and stapled.
